verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्याम् रामः सम्प्रस्थितः वनम् ।कृत स्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः ॥२-२६-१॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya tu kausalyām rāmaḥ samprasthitaḥ vanam ।kṛta svastyayano mātrā dharmiṣṭhe vartmani sthitaḥ ॥2-26-1॥

translations.english: After the benedictory rites were performed by his mother Kausalya, Rama paid obeisance to her and staying on the righteous path decided to depart to the forest. He entered the highway thronged with people and illumining it with his lustre and stirred their hearts with (remembrances of) his excellent virtues.

verses.sloka: विराजयन् राज सुतः राज मार्गम् नरैः वृतम् ।हृदयानि आममन्थ इव जनस्य गुणवत्तया ॥२-२६-२॥
verses.transliteration: virājayan rāja sutaḥ rāja mārgam naraiḥ vṛtam ।hṛdayāni āmamantha iva janasya guṇavattayā ॥2-26-2॥

translations.english: After the benedictory rites were performed by his mother Kausalya, Rama paid obeisance to her and staying on the righteous path decided to depart to the forest. He entered the highway thronged with people and illumining it with his lustre and stirred their hearts with (remembrances of) his excellent virtues.
translations.hindi: रोतो हई जानकी जी को उन्होंने फिर समझाया और धमोत्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने वन न जाने के, लिए सीता से यह कहा

verses.sloka: वैदेही च अपि तत् सर्वम् न शुश्राव तपस्विनी ।तत् एव हृदि तस्याः च यौवराज्य अभिषेचनम् ॥२-२६-३॥
verses.transliteration: vaidehī ca api tat sarvam na śuśrāva tapasvinī ।tat eva hṛdi tasyāḥ ca yauvarājya abhiṣecanam ॥2-26-3॥

translations.english: Sita, her mind preoccupied with thoughts about consecration, was engaged in religious austerities and hence could not hear of all this (development).
translations.hindi: , % पाठान्तरे —बाष्पदूषितलो चनाम्‌ | £ ` हे सीते! तू बडे कुलीन घर की लड़की है और सदा धमपालन में निरतं रहती है। अतः यहीं रह कर घमीचरण कर, जिससे मेरा -मन सुखी हो

verses.sloka: देव कार्यम् स्म सा कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्ट चेतना ।अभिज्ञा राज धर्मानाम् राज पुत्रम् प्रतीक्षते ॥२-२६-४॥
verses.transliteration: deva kāryam sma sā kṛtvā kṛtajñā hṛṣṭa cetanā ।abhijñā rāja dharmānām rāja putram pratīkṣate ॥2-26-4॥

translations.english: Experienced in palace rituals, Sita, grateful (to God) after performing worship of the deities was awaiting in a happy mood the arrival of the prince.
translations.hindi: हे अबले सीते ! मैं जो कहता हूँ तू बही कर | बनवास में बड़े बड़े कष्ट होते हैं । मैं बतलाता हूँ, तू उन्हें सुन

verses.sloka: प्रविवेश अथ रामः तु स्व वेश्म सुविभूषितम् ।प्रहृष्ट जन सम्पूर्णम् ह्रिया किम्चित् अवान् मुखः ॥२-२६-५॥
verses.transliteration: praviveśa atha rāmaḥ tu sva veśma suvibhūṣitam ।prahṛṣṭa jana sampūrṇam hriyā kimcit avān mukhaḥ ॥2-26-5॥

translations.english: His head bent down in embarrassment, Rama entered his welldecorated residence thronged with excited people.

verses.sloka: अथ सीता समुत्पत्य वेपमाना च तम् पतिम् ।अपश्यत् शोक सम्तप्तम् चिन्ता व्याकुलिल इन्द्रियम् ॥२-२६-६॥
verses.transliteration: atha sītā samutpatya vepamānā ca tam patim ।apaśyat śoka samtaptam cintā vyākulila indriyam ॥2-26-6॥

translations.english: Sita got up suddenly, (her limbs) trembling to see her husband distressed with grief and agitated with anxiety.
translations.hindi: में तेरी भलाई के लिए ही कहता हूँ । बन में कभी कुछ भी. सुख नहीं है । प्रत्युत बहाँ सदा कष्ट ही कष्ट हैं

verses.sloka: ताम् दृष्ट्वा स हि धर्मात्मा न शशाक मनोगतम् ।तम् शोकम् राघवह् सोढुम् ततो विवृतताम् गतः ॥२-२६-७॥
verses.transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā sa hi dharmātmā na śaśāka manogatam ।tam śokam rāghavah soḍhum tato vivṛtatām gataḥ ॥2-26-7॥

translations.english: On seeing her, virtuous Rama could not contain the sorrow in his mind which manifested (through his external appearance).

verses.sloka: विवर्ण वदनम् दृष्ट्वा तम् प्रस्विन्नम् अमर्षणम् ।आह दुह्ख अभिसम्तप्ता किम् इदानीम् इदम् प्रभो ॥२-२६-८॥
verses.transliteration: vivarṇa vadanam dṛṣṭvā tam prasvinnam amarṣaṇam ।āha duhkha abhisamtaptā kim idānīm idam prabho ॥2-26-8॥

translations.english: On seeing Rama with a pale face. indignant and heavily perspiring, Sita, consumed with grief said, My Lord, why are you now like this?
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! निन बन में निःशाङ्क हो क्रीड़ा करने वाले अनेक. वनजन्तु मनुष्य को देखते ही मार डालने के लिए आक्रमण करते हैं, अतः वनवास बड़ा कष्टदायी है.

verses.sloka: अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान् युक्तः पुष्यो न राघव ।प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वम् असि दुर्मनाः ॥२-२६-९॥
verses.transliteration: adya bārhaspataḥ śrīmān yuktaḥ puṣyo na rāghava ।procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prājñaiḥ kena tvam asi durmanāḥ ॥2-26-9॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu race, today has been declared by learned brahmins a suitable and auspicious day for consecration under Pushya star with Brihaspati as presiding deity. Then why are you dejected?

verses.sloka: न ते शत शलाकेन जल फेन निभेन च ।आवृतम् वदनम् वल्गु चत्रेण अभिविराजते ॥२-२६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: na te śata śalākena jala phena nibhena ca ।āvṛtam vadanam valgu catreṇa abhivirājate ॥2-26-10॥

translations.english: How is it that your charming face shines not today under a hundredribbed umbrella (white) like foam in water?
translations.hindi: प्रायः बनों के मार्ग पैर में लिपट जाने बाली वेलों और पैर में चुभ जांने वाले काँटो से पूर्ण रहते हे ओर, वहाँ वनकुक्कुट ( बन मुर्ग ) बोला करते हैं । रास्तों में दूर तक पीने को जल भी नहीँ मिलता । बन के रास्ते बड़े भयङ्कर होते हैं। अतः बन में बड़े क्लेश होते हैं

verses.sloka: व्यजनाभ्याम् च मुख्याभ्याम् शत पत्र निभ ईक्षणम् ।चन्द्र हम्स प्रकाशाभ्याम् वीज्यते न तव आननम् ॥२-२६-११॥
verses.transliteration: vyajanābhyām ca mukhyābhyām śata patra nibha īkṣaṇam ।candra hamsa prakāśābhyām vījyate na tava ānanam ॥2-26-11॥

translations.english: (How is it that) your face, with its lotuslike eyes is not being fanned by excellent fans of the colour of the Moon or the swan.
translations.hindi: दिन भर के थकेमाँ दे बनवासी को रात के समय सोने के. लिए कोमल गद्दे-तकिये नहीं, किन्तु-अपने आप सूख कर गिरी ह पत्तियां बिश्वा कर उन पर सोना पड़ता है । वहाँ पलंग ह [मलता प्रत्युत जमीन ही पर लेटना पड़ता है। अतएंब वन- चास बड़ा कष्टप्रद हे

verses.sloka: वाग्मिनो बन्दिनः च अपि प्रहृष्टाः त्वम् नर ऋषभ ।स्तुवन्तः न अद्य दृश्यन्ते मन्गलैः सूत मागधाः ॥२-२६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: vāgmino bandinaḥ ca api prahṛṣṭāḥ tvam nara ṛṣabha ।stuvantaḥ na adya dṛśyante mangalaiḥ sūta māgadhāḥ ॥2-26-12॥

translations.english: (How is it that) O best among men eloquent panegyrists, charioteers, bards are not seen singing your praise with auspicious words?
translations.hindi: रे | + वीज ना की अन्य वस्तुओं पर मनन चला, सायं ' रंत सं गिरे हुए फल खा कर ही सन्तोष ह अतः बन में कष्ट हैं

verses.sloka: न ते क्षौद्रम् च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः ।मूर्ध्नि मूर्ध अवसिक्तस्य दधति स्म विधानतः ॥२-२६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: na te kṣaudram ca dadhi ca brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ ।mūrdhni mūrdha avasiktasya dadhati sma vidhānataḥ ॥2-26-13॥

translations.english: How is it that brahmins versed in the Vedas have not duly sprinkled the mixture of honey and curd on your head (prior to your consecration)?

verses.sloka: न त्वाम् प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणी मुख्याः च भूषिताः ।अनुव्रजितुम् इच्चन्ति पौर जापपदाः तथा ॥२-२६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: na tvām prakṛtayaḥ sarvā śreṇī mukhyāḥ ca bhūṣitāḥ ।anuvrajitum iccanti paura jāpapadāḥ tathā ॥2-26-14॥

translations.english: How is it that welladorned ministers, citizens from towns and villages, heads of guilds and others do not follow you?
translations.hindi: हे मेथिलि ! बन में यथाशक्ति उपवास र न है भी करन आर रक्ष | छाल, वस्त्रो की जगह पहननी पड़ती है, १ र | च द देवतानां पितणां च कतेव्यं विधिपूवकम | ` मापानामतिथीनां च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम्‌

verses.sloka: चतुर्भिर् वेग सम्पन्नैः हयैः कान्चन भूषणैः ।मुख्यः पुष्य रथो युक्तः किम् न गच्चति ते अग्रतः ॥२-२६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: caturbhir vega sampannaiḥ hayaiḥ kāncana bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।mukhyaḥ puṣya ratho yuktaḥ kim na gaccati te agrataḥ ॥2-26-15॥

translations.english: How is it that the chief ceremonial chariot, decorated with gold and harnessed by four galloping horses is not preceding you?

verses.sloka: न हस्ती च अग्रतः श्रीमाम्स् तव लक्षण पूजितः ।प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्ण मेघ गिरि प्रभः ॥२-२६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: na hastī ca agrataḥ śrīmāms tava lakṣaṇa pūjitaḥ ।prayāṇe lakṣyate vīra kṛṣṇa megha giri prabhaḥ ॥2-26-16॥

translations.english: How is it that the elephant, whose lustre resembles that of a mountain or a dark cloud and endowed with auspicious features is not seen leading your procession, O valiant one
translations.hindi: हे बाले ! बन में अपने हाथ से फूल तोड़ कर, ऋषियों की बतलाई हुई विधि से वेदी की पूजा करनी पड़ती है, इस लिए बन में क्लेश ही क्लेशा हैं

verses.sloka: न च कान्चन चित्रम् ते पश्यामि प्रिय दर्शन ।भद्र आसनम् पुरः कृत्य यान्तम् वीर पुरह्सरम् ॥२-२६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: na ca kāncana citram te paśyāmi priya darśana ।bhadra āsanam puraḥ kṛtya yāntam vīra purahsaram ॥2-26-17॥

translations.english: O heroic one O handsome one how is it that I do not see your attendants proceeding in front with the throne carved in gold?
translations.hindi: वहाँ देवताओं ओर पितरों तथा समय पर आए हुए अतिथि का विधिपूवक नित्य पूजन करना पड़ता है

verses.sloka: अभिषेको यदा सज्जः किम् इदानीम् इदम् तव ।अपूर्वो मुख वर्णः च न प्रहर्षः च लक्ष्यते ॥२-२६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣeko yadā sajjaḥ kim idānīm idam tava ।apūrvo mukha varṇaḥ ca na praharṣaḥ ca lakṣyate ॥2-26-18॥

translations.english: How is it that when arrangements are under way now for your consecration, the complexion of your countenance does not look like what it was before? There is no joy on your face.
translations.hindi: बनों में बड़ी आँधी चला करती हैं, अंधेरा भी छा जाता है, नित्य ही भूख भी बहुत अधिक लगती है ओर वहाँ ओर भी अनेक भय के कारण उपस्थित रहते हैं। अतः बनवास वड़ा कष्टदायी है

verses.sloka: इति इव विलपन्तीम् ताम् प्रोवाच रघु नन्दनः ।सीते तत्रभवाम्स् तात प्रव्राजयति माम् वनम् ॥२-२६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: iti iva vilapantīm tām provāca raghu nandanaḥ ।sīte tatrabhavāms tāta pravrājayati mām vanam ॥2-26-19॥

translations.english: O Sita my venerable father is banishing me to the forest, said Rama, the scion of the Raghus, the joy of the Raghu race, seeing her thus lamenting.

verses.sloka: कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्म चारिणि ।शृणु जानकि येन इदम् क्रमेण अभ्यागतम् मम ॥२-२६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: kule mahati sambhūte dharmajñe dharma cāriṇi ।śṛṇu jānaki yena idam krameṇa abhyāgatam mama ॥2-26-20॥

translations.english: You were born in a noble family. You know and practise dharma. I shall tell you how this banishment has come about. Do listen.
translations.hindi: वहाँ नदियों में रहने वाले, साँप जो नदी ही की तरह टेढी- मेढी चाल से चला करते हैं, माग रोक कर सामने खड़े हो जाते हैं। अतएव बनवास बड़ा दुःखदायी है

verses.sloka: राज्ञा सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे ।कैकेय्यै प्रीत मनसा पुरा दत्तौ महा वरौ ॥२-२६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: rājñā satya pratijñena pitrā daśarathena me ।kaikeyyai prīta manasā purā dattau mahā varau ॥2-26-21॥

translations.english: My father, king Dasaratha, true to his promise, had earlier granted two great boons to my mother Kaikeyi.
translations.hindi: र अबल्ले ! वहाँ फतंगे, बिच्छू, कोडे, बनैले मक्खियाँ, मच्छर आदि नित्य हो सताया करते हैं। अतएव वनवास बड़ा क़्लेश- कारक है

verses.sloka: तया अद्य मम सज्जे अस्मिन्न् अभिषेके नृप उद्यते ।प्रचोदितः स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः ॥२-२६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: tayā adya mama sajje asminn abhiṣeke nṛpa udyate ।pracoditaḥ sa samayo dharmeṇa pratinirjitaḥ ॥2-26-22॥

translations.english: When the king was preparing for my consecration, she reminded him of the promise and in the name of righteousness he has been cornered.
translations.hindi: ह्‌ भामिनी ! काँटे ओर कुशकाश की तरह पत्तो अर बन्नैले बृत्त से सारा बन भरा हुआ है। अतः वनवास बड़ा हु है

verses.sloka: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यम् दण्डके मया ।पित्रा मे भरतः च अपि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः ॥२-२६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vastavyam daṇḍake mayā ।pitrā me bharataḥ ca api yauvarājye niyojitaḥ ॥2-26-23॥

translations.english: I am to dwell in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years while father has appointed Bharata princeregent.
translations.hindi: फिर बन'में रहने से अनेक शारीरिक क्लेश तोते हैं और नाना प्रकार के भय -उत्पन्न हुआ करते हैं। अतएब वनवास वडा दुःखदायी है

verses.sloka: सो अहम् त्वाम् आगतः द्रष्टुम् प्रस्थितः विजनम् वनम् ।भरतस्य समीपे ते न अहम् कथ्यः कदाचन ॥२-२६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: so aham tvām āgataḥ draṣṭum prasthitaḥ vijanam vanam ।bharatasya samīpe te na aham kathyaḥ kadācana ॥2-26-24॥

translations.english: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.
translations.hindi: ॥ १ सत्यत्रते-- श्रमो घन्नतं । (यो०) २ व्यलीक अर प्रिय । (मोः) भ ४ अष्टाविश: सग: ३२१ हे सीते ! वन में, क्रोध और लोभ को त्याग कर तप में मन लगाना पड़ता है। डरने योग्य वस्तुओं से भी डरना नहीं होता-- ` अतः वनवास दुःखम्रद है

verses.sloka: ऋद्धि युक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते पर स्तवम् ।तस्मान् न ते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्य अग्रतः मम ॥२-२६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: ṛddhi yuktā hi puruṣā na sahante para stavam ।tasmān na te guṇāḥ kathyā bharatasya agrataḥ mama ॥2-26-25॥

translations.english: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.

verses.sloka: न अपि त्वम् तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचनअनुकूलतया शक्यम् समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम् ॥२-२६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: na api tvam tena bhartavyā viśeṣeṇa kadācanaanukūlatayā śakyam samīpe tasya vartitum ॥2-26-26॥

translations.english: Never expect special treatment from Bharata. You can (continue to) stay with him (here) by conducting yourself in a favourable manner.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार जब सीता जी को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने बन में ले जाना न चाहा, तब सीता जौ.उनकी इस बात को न मान कर ओर अत्यन्त दुःखी हो, यह बोलीं

verses.sloka: तस्मै दत्तम् नृवतिना यौवराज्यम् सनातनम् ।स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः ॥२-२६-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tasmai dattam nṛvatinā yauvarājyam sanātanam ।sa prasādyastvayā sīte nṛpatiśca viśeṣataḥ ॥2-26-27॥

translations.english: O Sita the king has conferred the hereditary regency on him. Therefore, O Sita, you must make efforts to win his favour, especially a king's.

verses.sloka: अहम् च अपि प्रतिज्ञाम् ताम् गुरोह् समनुपालयन् ।वनम् अद्य एव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि ॥२-२६-२८॥
verses.transliteration: aham ca api pratijñām tām guroh samanupālayan ।vanam adya eva yāsyāmi sthirā bhava manasvini ॥2-26-28॥

translations.english: I am leaving for the forest right away for fulfilling my father's pledge. O highminded Sita be steady.

verses.sloka: याते च मयि कल्याणि वनम् मुनि निषेवितम् ।व्रत उपवास रतया भवितव्यम् त्वया अनघे ॥२-२६-२९॥
verses.transliteration: yāte ca mayi kalyāṇi vanam muni niṣevitam ।vrata upavāsa ratayā bhavitavyam tvayā anaghe ॥2-26-29॥

translations.english: O sinless, auspicious one engage yourself in vratas and fasting after my departure to the forest inhabited by ascetics.

verses.sloka: काल्यम् उत्थाय देवानाम् कृत्वा पूजाम् यथा विधि ।वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नर ईश्वरः ॥२-२६-३०॥
verses.transliteration: kālyam utthāya devānām kṛtvā pūjām yathā vidhi ।vanditavyo daśarathaḥ pitā mama nara īśvaraḥ ॥2-26-30॥

translations.english: You must rise in time and with the (household) gods duly worshipped, pay obeisance to my father, king Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा सम्ताप कर्शिता ।धर्मम् एव अग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानम् अर्हति ॥२-२६-३१॥
verses.transliteration: mātā ca mama kausalyā vṛddhā samtāpa karśitā ।dharmam eva agrataḥ kṛtvā tvattaḥ sammānam arhati ॥2-26-31॥

translations.english: You should give importance to duty(dharma) and show respect to my aged mother who is emaciated due to grief.

verses.sloka: वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः ।स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः ॥२-२६-३२॥
verses.transliteration: vanditavyāḥ ca te nityam yāḥ śeṣā mama mātaraḥ ।sneha praṇaya sambhogaiḥ samā hi mama mātaraḥ ॥2-26-32॥

translations.english: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.

verses.sloka: भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः ।त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम ॥२-२६-३३॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛ putra samau ca api draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ ।tvayā lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau prāṇaiḥ priyatarau mama ॥2-26-33॥

translations.english: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.

verses.sloka: विप्रियम् न च कर्तव्यम् भरतस्य कदाचन ।स हि राजा प्रभुः चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च ॥२-२६-३४॥
verses.transliteration: vipriyam na ca kartavyam bharatasya kadācana ।sa hi rājā prabhuḥ caiva deśasya ca kulasya ca ॥2-26-34॥

translations.english: Now Bharata is the king of the country and head of the family. Therefore, you should never do anything disagreeable to him.

verses.sloka: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैः च उपसेविताः ।राजानः सम्प्रसीदन्ति प्रकुप्यन्ति विपर्यये ॥२-२६-३५॥
verses.transliteration: ārādhitā hi śīlena prayatnaiḥ ca upasevitāḥ ।rājānaḥ samprasīdanti prakupyanti viparyaye ॥2-26-35॥

translations.english: Kings are gratified if they are served with zeal and good conduct. If the contrary happens, they get provoked.

verses.sloka: औरसान् अपि पुत्रान् हि त्यजन्ति अहित कारिणः ।समर्थान् सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनान् अपि नर अधिपाः ॥२-२६-३६॥
verses.transliteration: aurasān api putrān hi tyajanti ahita kāriṇaḥ ।samarthān sampragṛhṇanti janān api nara adhipāḥ ॥2-26-36॥

translations.english: Kings abandon (even) their own sons if they are harmful and receive capable people even if they are strangers.

verses.sloka: सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी ।भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा ॥२-२६-३७॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvam vaseha kalyāṇi rājñaḥ samanuvartinī ।bharatasya ratā dharme satyavrataparāyaṇā ॥2-26-37॥

translations.english: O auspicious one live here by being obedient to king Bharata. Absorbed in righteousness, follow truth and (religious) vows.

verses.sloka: अहम् गमिष्यामि महा वनम् प्रिये ।त्वया हि वस्तव्यम् इह एव भामिनि ।यथा व्यलीकम् कुरुषे न कस्यचित् ।तथा त्वया कार्यम् इदम् वचो मम ॥२-२६-३८॥
verses.transliteration: aham gamiṣyāmi mahā vanam priye ।tvayā hi vastavyam iha eva bhāmini ।yathā vyalīkam kuruṣe na kasyacit ।tathā tvayā kāryam idam vaco mama ॥2-26-38॥

translations.english: O my beloved Sita I am going to the wild forest. Stay here and never cause displeasure to any one in any way. Could you carry out these words of mine? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षड्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
